title: Rav Dimi bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 53b: “Rav Zevid — and some say Rav Dimi bar Abba — said: the dispute concerns one who forgot; if deliberately, all agree that he must return to his place and bless.” In Avodah Zarah 15b he said: “Just as it is forbidden to sell to a gentile, so it is forbidden to sell to an Israelite suspected of selling to a gentile.”
